name: Saad-SR
description: A scale-aware aerial dataset and benchmark for evaluating robustness of object representations under UAV-induced scale shifts in aerial imagery.
reputation: A niche dataset used in UAV/aerial-vision research to study scale robustness; cited within the aerial-imagery community but not broadly adopted outside that field.
notes: Domain-specific (UAV/aerial imagery) and focused on scale-shift robustness; relatively small compared to large detection corpora, so results may not generalize to generic object-detection benchmarks; not an LLM benchmark.
